crumbling_keep.base: The keep stands as a skeletal ruin against the raging storm. Its jagged stone teeth hint at once-majestic towers, and within its crumbling corridors lie decaying libraries and spectral remnants of knowledge.

reactions.text: Master Alaric's guidance now seems to echo in the empty halls, his teachings etched into the very stones.
Scattered pages of ancient lore have been gathered from the dust, revealing secrets of a bygone era.
The hidden sanctum has been breached, its dim pulse of magic now a beacon in the gloom.
The wards of the keep flicker with renewed energy, a testament to a ritual that may yet save this place from oblivion.

storm_wracked_coast.base: This treacherous shoreline is a gauntlet of biting winds and unrelenting waves, carving the cliffs into skeletal shapes. The boundary between land and sea is blurred by a ceaseless tumult.

reactions.text: Kaelen the Coastblade has been seen surveying these rocks, his presence a reminder of raids past and allegiances forged.
Long-lost relics, weathered by the storm's fury, now lie exposed on the tide-pooled rocks as if beckoning to those who dare claim them.
The Marauders' banners flutter defiantly on the wind, a symbol of their enduring claim over these ruins.

whispering_marsh.base: A fetid, mist-shrouded expanse sprawls southward from the keep. Home to creatures twisted by dark energies, it is both a refuge and a death trap, its voices in the mists holding truths lost to sane minds.

reactions.text: The mists now murmur with secrets unearthed, their whispers a chilling testament to the marsh's ancient lore.
The twisted forms of marsh denizens seem to bow in reverence, their existence forever altered by the player's passage.
A spectral figure, once a lost soul of the marsh, now drifts freely—a silent witness to the changes wrought by daring deeds.
